title: MarketStateMessage
description: Dynamic state of one market, broadcast to EVERY session of the world: after SESSION_READY, in every tick a sale changed it, and in every recovery-multiple tick in which some listed mineral's effective saturation actually changed (at most once per recovery interval). Full state, not a delta. listings holds ONLY minerals with at least one revealed deposit in the star system (simulation state first_extracted_tick - never the history tables, spec p1-03 I-86): an unrevealed mineral's name and value are not on the wire. Ascending mineral_id. price_cr_per_kg is derived by the server from saturation and the data table at `tick` and is not stored anywhere. last_sale is the market's public notice board - the trace a later player sees (design doc section 4): who sold how much of it last, and when; null if never sold in this world. THE CLIENT NEVER COMPUTES A CURRENT PRICE OR SATURATION (spec p1-03 I-78).

last_sale.description: The last accepted sale of this mineral here, or null. Persisted market state: survives restarts and the seller's departure.

actor_id.description: Seller. Shown as the p1-02 I-66 'Pilot-xxxx' tag; never a key for anything but this display.

tick.description: Tick of that sale. The client shows the elapsed time from the envelope tick.
